main.summary: Download session that persists local state and retrieves ranges from DataControl.

field.name: DownloadRequestSizeBytes
field.summary: Maximum number of payload bytes this session requests from the server in a single download operation, for both segmented and stream-follow reads.

field.name: DownloadStateRefreshInterval
field.summary: Maximum interval between authoritative state refreshes during a follow wait.

field.name: client
field.summary: The DataControl client used to issue segmented or stream transfer service calls.

field.name: storage
field.summary: The local working directory storage that persists segmented or stream download state and content.

field.name: token
field.summary: The optional bearer token used for authenticated service calls.

field.name: FollowStream
field.summary: The optional buffered follow stream used for stream-follow downloads.

field.name: FollowSubscription
field.summary: The optional persistent follow notification subscription owned for the lifetime of this download session object.

field.name: disposed
field.summary: Tracks whether the download session has already released its owned resources.

field.name: OperationGate
field.summary: Per-session asynchronous gate that serializes operations which read or modify download state, local files, and owned follow resources.

field.name: PendingStreamCheckpoint
field.summary: Candidate stream checkpoint requiring reconciliation if its persistence outcome is uncertain.

field.name: ShutdownCancellation
field.summary: Session-owned cancellation signal that interrupts pending follow waits before disposal waits for the operation gate.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create a client-side download session wrapper.
constructor.param: The DataControl client used for service calls.
The local working directory storage for the session.
Optional bearer token used for authenticated service calls.
The current persisted session metadata and transfer state.
Optional buffered follow stream used for stream-follow downloads.
Optional live item being downloaded in the session.
Optional persistent follow notification subscription owned by the session for its object lifetime.
Maximum payload bytes requested by this session per download operation; must be positive.
Maximum duration between authoritative state refreshes while waiting for follow data.

property.name: Session
property.summary: Gets the current local download session metadata and transfer state snapshot.

property.name: LiveItem
property.summary: Gets the current live item being downloaded in the session, if any.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Cancel a pending follow wait, then release the session-owned buffered follow stream and persistent follow notification subscription after active session work leaves the operation gate.

method.name: Close
method.summary: Explicitly close the retained read session on DataControl and remove its local session state when the server permits closure.
method.param: Cancellation token.
method.returns: True when the remote read session was closed and local state removed; otherwise false.
method.exception: Thrown when the download session has been disposed.

method.name: Abort
method.summary: Abort a writable upload session, or close a retained read session using the read-authorized close operation.
method.param: Cancellation token.
method.returns: True when the remote session was aborted or closed and local state removed; otherwise false.
method.exception: Thrown when the download session has been disposed.

method.name: AbortCore
method.summary: Run the correct remote lifecycle operation for the session mode and remove local state after success while the session operation gate is held.
method.param: Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when the remote transfer was aborted and local state was removed; otherwise false.

method.name: CloseCore
method.summary: Run the remote read-session close and local cleanup while the session operation gate is held.
method.param: Cancellation token.
method.returns: True when the remote session was closed and local state removed; otherwise false.

method.name: DeleteLocalSessionAsync
method.summary: Remove the locally persisted download session after a successful remote abort or close.
method.param: Cancellation token.

method.name: DeleteLocalStateCore
method.summary: Delete the local download session state while the session operation gate is held.
method.param: Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when the local session state directory is deleted successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: DisposeAsync
method.summary: Cancel a pending follow wait, then asynchronously release the session-owned persistent follow notification subscription and buffered follow stream resources after active session work leaves the operation gate.
method.returns: A value task that completes when the session-owned resources have been released.

method.name: DownloadNextCore
method.summary: Run one finite range or stream-follow download while the session operation gate is held.
method.param: Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when the next download operation succeeds and local state is refreshed; otherwise false.

method.name: WaitForFollowWakeAsync
method.summary: Wait for a wake signal from the session-owned persistent follow notification subscription, or fall back to a direct delay when the session has no subscription mapping. Each wait is capped by the configured download-state refresh interval so the caller rechecks authoritative state periodically. The caller token and session shutdown signal can both cancel the wait.
method.param: Wait duration to apply for the current follow wait cycle.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes when the session receives a wake signal, the bounded wait elapses, or cancellation is requested.

method.name: DownloadToCompletionCore
method.summary: Run the download-to-completion loop while the session operation gate is held.
method.param: Optional progress receiver notified after each successfully downloaded finite segment or stream extent.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with the number of successfully downloaded finite segments or stream extents.

method.name: DownloadNext
method.summary: Download the next planned missing range into the local working directory and refresh persisted state.
method.param: Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when a segment download succeeds and local state is refreshed; otherwise false.
method.exception: Thrown when the download session has been disposed.

method.name: DownloadToCurrentCore
method.summary: Run the current-data download loop while the session operation gate is held.
method.param: Optional progress receiver notified after each successfully downloaded finite segment or stream extent.
Optional wait duration to use when no additional data is currently available.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with the number of successfully downloaded finite segments or stream extents.

method.name: DownloadSegmentNext
method.summary: Download the next planned finite segmented range into the local working directory and return the exact range realized for progress reporting.
method.param: Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with the exact segmented range downloaded and persisted locally, or null when no segmented download can be performed or the operation does not succeed.

method.name: MaterializeCore
method.summary: Run materialization and optional export while the session operation gate is held.
method.param: Optional destination directory for the materialized object and stream files.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with the materialized download result, or null when the local state is incomplete, invalid, or cannot be safely exported.

method.name: ReOpenSegmentedFollowSession
method.summary: Re-open a segmented follow download session against the current source identity and persist the refreshed follow state while preserving already realized local ranges.
method.param: The current segmented follow transfer state whose source identity and realized local ranges must be preserved across the re-open call.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes after the refreshed follow state has been persisted locally, or returns without changes when the re-open call does not produce a compatible state.

method.name: RemoveTransferCore
method.summary: Run remote transfer removal and local cleanup while the session operation gate is held.
method.param: Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when the remote removal succeeds and local state is removed; otherwise false.

method.name: DownloadToCompletion
method.summary: Download remaining finite ranges or stream-follow extents until the source session reaches a terminal state or cancellation is requested. Caller cancellation or session disposal can cancel a pending follow wait. Cancellation leaves local session data available for resumption and does not materialize a partial item.
method.param: Optional receiver first notified with the persisted session identity and current byte state, then after each successfully downloaded and persisted range or stream extent.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with the number of successfully downloaded finite segments or stream extents.
method.exception: Thrown when the download session has been disposed.
Thrown when caller cancellation is requested or the session is disposed during an active follow wait. The local session remains available for resumption.

method.name: DownloadToCurrent
method.summary: Download remaining finite ranges or stream-follow extents that are currently available, then return without waiting for the source session to reach a terminal state. Caller cancellation or session disposal can cancel a pending follow wait.
method.param: Optional receiver first notified with the persisted session identity and current byte state, then after each successfully downloaded and persisted range or stream extent.
Optional wait duration to use when no additional data is currently available. Use to avoid waiting.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with the number of successfully downloaded finite segments or stream extents materialized during the catch-up pass.
method.exception: Thrown when the download session has been disposed.
Thrown when caller cancellation is requested or the session is disposed during an active follow wait.

method.name: DownloadCore
method.summary: Run the shared segmented and stream follow download loop used by both terminal completion and catch-up-to-current entry points.
method.param: Optional progress receiver notified after each successful download.
Wait duration used when additional follow data is not currently available. keeps waiting until terminal conditions or cancellation, while disables waiting.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with the number of successfully downloaded finite segments or stream extents.

method.name: Materialize
method.summary: Materialize the downloaded item from the local working-directory session state when the session has sufficient local content for the active transfer family.
method.param: Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with the materialized download result, or null when the local state is incomplete or invalid.
method.exception: Thrown when the download session has been disposed.

method.name: MaterializeWithDestination
method.summary: Materialize the downloaded item and, when a destination directory is supplied, export both materialized files into that directory before retiring the local session state.
method.param: Optional destination directory for the materialized object and stream files. When omitted, the materialized item remains bound to the session-managed files in the local working directory.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with the materialized download result, or null when the local state is incomplete, invalid, or cannot be safely exported.
method.remarks: Supplying a destination directory performs a one-way export of the object payload and stream file. Active stream-follow sessions may refuse export until the stream becomes terminal.
method.exception: Thrown when the download session has been disposed.

method.name: DeleteLocalState
method.summary: Delete the local working directory state for the current download session without contacting the service.
method.param: Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when the local session state directory is deleted successfully; otherwise false.
method.exception: Thrown when the download session has been disposed.

method.name: RemoveTransfer
method.summary: Remove the retained remote download transfer session and delete the corresponding local working directory state.
method.param: Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when the remote removal succeeds and local state is removed; otherwise false.
method.exception: Thrown when the download session has been disposed.

method.name: CreateProgress
method.summary: Create a segmented download progress snapshot, including the initial session-identifying snapshot when no range has yet been downloaded.
method.param: The refreshed transfer state after the successful download.
The range most recently downloaded, or null for the initial snapshot.
method.returns: A progress snapshot describing the updated download state.

method.name: CreateProgressSnapshot
method.summary: Create an initial download progress snapshot from the current segmented or stream transfer state.
method.param: Current transfer state to represent.
method.returns: A progress snapshot describing the current download state without a newly downloaded range or extent.

method.name: CreateSegmentedProgress
method.summary: Create a segmented download progress snapshot from the current state and optional latest downloaded range.
method.param: Current segmented transfer state.
The range most recently downloaded, or null for the initial snapshot.
method.returns: A progress snapshot describing the segmented download state.

method.name: CreateStreamProgress
method.summary: Create a stream-follow progress snapshot, including the initial session-identifying snapshot when no extent has yet been downloaded.
method.param: The refreshed stream transfer state after the successful download.
The footer describing the most recently downloaded stream extent, or null for the initial snapshot.
method.returns: A progress snapshot describing the updated stream-follow state.

method.name: DownloadStreamNext
method.summary: Download the next available stream-follow extent into the local stream working directory and refresh persisted stream state.
method.param: Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with the downloaded stream extent details after the payload and refreshed state are persisted, or null when no extent is downloaded.
method.remarks: The cancellation token applies to remote calls and state refresh before the extent is downloaded.

method.name: MaterializeStream
method.summary: Materialize the current stream-follow item view from the local stream working directory, or export both files to a destination directory when the stream session is eligible for terminal export.
method.param: Optional destination directory for the materialized object and stream files.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with the materialized stream download result, or null when the local state is incomplete or invalid.

method.name: BindMaterializedStreamPath
method.summary: Bind the resolved local materialized stream file path onto the downloaded item using the appropriate item-type-specific file binding behavior.
method.param: The downloaded item instance being materialized from the local session working directory.
The resolved local materialized file path for the downloaded stream content.
True when the materialized stream file is the authoritative content source.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when the item successfully binds or rebinds to the local materialized stream file path; otherwise false.

method.name: VerifyMaterializationAsync
method.summary: Verify the local object payload and stream bytes against fresh authoritative evidence for the exact materialized prefix.
method.param: Transfer session identifier.
Data item identifier.
Expected canonical source session identifier, when the download session follows a source.
Expected SHA-512 of the serialized published object payload.
Server-authoritative ordered integrity summary for the published stream payload.
Expected realized stream length in bytes.
Local serialized object payload bytes loaded from working-directory state.
Local materialized stream file path to validate.
Transfer family for the requested evidence.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: Authoritative evidence when local content is valid; otherwise null.

method.name: VerifyObjectPayloadAsync
method.summary: Verify the local serialized object payload bytes against the expected published object hash.
method.param: Expected SHA-512 of the serialized published object payload.
Local serialized object payload bytes loaded from working-directory state.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when the local serialized object payload matches the expected published object hash; otherwise false.

method.name: VerifyStreamPayloadAsync
method.summary: Verify local stream bytes against canonical server-authoritative segment hashes and the integrity tree.
method.param: Server-authoritative integrity evidence for the exact materialized prefix.
Local materialized stream file path to validate.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when each local segment hash and the recomputed tree match the authoritative evidence; otherwise false.

method.name: HashNextStreamSegmentAsync
method.summary: Read exactly the requested number of bytes from a stream and compute their SHA-512 digest.
method.param: Stream containing the segment bytes.
Number of bytes to read and hash.
Token used to cancel asynchronous reads.
method.returns: The SHA-512 digest, or an empty array if the stream ends before the requested segment length is read.
method.exception: The cancellation token was canceled during a read.

method.name: IntegrityMatches
method.summary: Compare two optional ordered integrity summaries for equivalent algorithm, length, segment count, and digest values.
method.param: First integrity summary to compare.
Second integrity summary to compare.
method.returns: True when both summaries are absent or their algorithm, length, segment count, and digest values match; otherwise false.

method.name: PlanNextDownloadLength
method.summary: Plan the next stream-follow extent length using the currently available remote bytes and the configured maximum byte allowance.
method.param: Number of bytes currently available from the source beyond the realized local length.
method.returns: The number of bytes to request in the next stream-follow segment download, or zero when no additional bytes should be requested.

method.name: ExportMaterializedFile
method.summary: Copy a session-managed materialized file into a temporary destination file, verify it, and commit it under the preferred file name when available.
method.param: Current session-managed materialized file path.
Requested export directory.
Optional preferred path whose file name should be preserved.
Validates existing and temporary files against the expected object hash or stream integrity.
Cancellation Token.
Other managed paths that must not collide with the export target.
method.returns: A task that completes with the exported path, or null when a conflicting target or invalid export is encountered.

method.name: GetMaterializedTargetPath
method.summary: Build the target materialized file path using the requested directory and the preferred file name when one is available.
method.param: Current materialized file path.
Target directory for the materialized file.
Optional preferred stored path whose file name should be preserved.
method.returns: Resolved target materialized file path.

method.name: VerifyObjectFileAsync
method.summary: Asynchronously hash an exported object file and compare it with the expected SHA-512 digest.
method.param: Path to the exported object file.
Expected 64-byte SHA-512 digest of the serialized object payload.
Cancellation token.
method.returns: True when the file exists and its SHA-512 digest matches the expected value; otherwise false.

method.name: AreSamePath
method.summary: Determine whether two file paths refer to the same location, ignoring case differences.
method.param: The first file path to compare.
The second file path to compare.
method.returns: True when the paths refer to the same location; otherwise false.

method.name: PathsMatch
method.summary: Determine whether two file paths match.
method.param: The current file path to compare.
The target file path to compare.
method.returns: True when the paths refer to the same location; otherwise false.

method.name: IsFaultedOrAborted
method.summary: Determine whether a segmented download state has reached an aborted or faulted terminal condition.
method.param: The segmented download state to inspect.
method.returns: True when the segmented download state is aborted or faulted; otherwise false.

method.name: IsPublishedReadTerminal
method.summary: Determine whether a PublishedRead segmented download state is terminal because no local missing ranges remain.
method.param: The segmented download state to inspect.
method.returns: True when the download has been promoted to PublishedRead mode and all missing ranges have been realized locally; otherwise false.

method.name: IsCaughtUpStagedFollow
method.summary: Determine whether a staged-follow segmented download is locally caught up to the currently available source extent.
method.param: The segmented download state to inspect.
method.returns: True when the download remains in staged-follow mode and has no missing ranges at the moment; otherwise false.

method.name: NeedsPublishedReadPromotion
method.summary: Determine whether a staged-follow segmented download has observed source publication and should keep reopening until the session promotes to PublishedRead.
method.param: The segmented download state to inspect.
method.returns: True when the download is still in staged-follow mode while its status reflects source publication; otherwise false.

method.name: CanWaitForStagedFollowData
method.summary: Determine whether a staged-follow segmented download is eligible to wait for additional data or a publication transition.
method.param: The segmented download state to inspect.
Whether the caller requested follow waiting.
method.returns: True when the session is still in staged-follow mode, waiting is enabled, and the state is not complete, aborted, or faulted; otherwise false.

method.name: ShouldStopCaughtUpStagedFollow
method.summary: Determine whether a staged-follow segmented download that is currently caught up should stop instead of waiting for additional source progress.
method.param: The segmented download state to inspect.
Whether the caller requested follow waiting.
method.returns: True when waiting is disabled or the state is aborted or faulted; otherwise false.

method.name: ShouldContinueAfterStagedFollowReopen
method.summary: Determine whether the segmented follow loop should continue immediately after a promotion-aware reopen refresh.
method.param: The segmented download state to inspect.
method.returns: True when the refreshed state has become terminal, needs PublishedRead promotion handling, has newly available missing ranges, or has otherwise left the staged-follow caught-up waiting state; otherwise false.

method.name: PlanNextRange
method.summary: Plan the next download range from the first normalized missing range using the effective segment size policy.
method.param: The current download transfer state.
method.remarks: The algorithm starts from the first missing range. It then clamps the preferred segment size into the configured minimum and maximum bounds. If taking that planned prefix would leave behind a non-terminal tail smaller than the minimum segment size, the current request is reduced so the remaining tail grows back to at least the minimum size. When no split is needed, the original missing range is returned unchanged.
method.returns: The next range to download.

method.name: HasReachedConfiguredByteLimit
method.summary: Determine whether the current stream-follow download state has reached the configured maximum byte count.
method.param: The current stream-follow download state.
method.returns: True when a maximum byte count is configured and the appended length meets or exceeds it; otherwise false.
